title: Named scalar and finite evaluation comparison
statement: For Chern data c and an arbitrary integral arrow f from the Rrings unit to c.rootModule shifted by two, and any level n, ScalarFiniteBoundary is the actual finiteBoundaryEquality [def-sp-tower-class-finite] of scalarChernArrow [def-sfb-scalar-chern-arrow] after evaluation, target transport by lineEvaluation and forgetting scalars. The source map is finiteQuotient, the target map is finiteRootMap, and the integral comparison arrow is finite evaluation of underlyingChernArrow [def-sfb-tower-underlying-arrow] of f, with integerGenerator and rootForget at its endpoints. It assumes no integral Kummer normalization and is a fully constructed proposition, with no chosen object or hole. The standard Fact wrapper stores precisely this equality in its out field; no additional condition or data is supplied.

def ScalarFiniteBoundary (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    {T : Scheme.{u}} (c : Chern l E T)
    (f : unit T (Rrings l T) ⟶
      ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (Systems T (Rrings l T)) 0).obj
        c.rootModule)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧) (n : ℕ) : Prop
